paragraph: Teddy, a small dog, spent nearly three weeks on Helvellyn, the third-highest peak in rural England's Lake District. She had vanished on August 2nd while hiking with her owner. Posters went up around the area, but for almost three weeks no one found her. Then a team of rescuers reached the steep ravine where she was stuck and brought her down. Her owner got her back after twenty days on a mountain.
